title: Validation Period Allowance on Initial Military Service Documentation
content:
**Validation desk note — Hardship and Protective Holds.** The validation allowance of the initial service documentation on a Military Service Hold request depends on the requested account's validation period, as shown in its Placed Consumer Accounts record (its status and the last day of its validation period). The allowance is added once to the days allowed for the initial service documentation.

| The requested account | Validation allowance |
|---|---|
| Status still validation period, and its validation period ends after today | 5 calendar days (validation-open days) |
| Its validation period ended no more than the recent-validation window of 30 calendar days ago — its last day falling on today or on one of the 30 calendar days before today | 2 calendar days (recent-validation days) |
| Otherwise | Nothing |

## Dated cases (hypothetical; today is 10 June)

| Status | Last day of the validation period | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Validation period | 25 June | 5 days |
| Validation period | 10 June (today) | 2 days |
| Active | 1 June | 2 days |
| Active | 11 May (30 days before) | 2 days |
| Active | 10 May (31 days before) | Nothing |

The first row needs both parts: the status must still be validation period and the last day must fall after today.
